answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 9069 Country: India Title: Please clarify whether musafah has to be done with one hand or two hands. which is the sunnath method. Question: Please clarify whether musafah has to be done with one hand or two hands. which is the sunnath method. Answer ID: 9069 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1535/1276=L/1429) The musafaha (shaking hands) with two hands is sunnah: وفي القنیۃ: السنۃ في المصافحۃ بکلتا یدیہ ( الدر المختار مع الشام ي 9:548 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
